business_meaning: Unique savings account number / natural key
documented_rules: Unique savings account number; unique per account version; varchar(20) recommended. [[1]]
inferred_rules: Non-null; trimmed; unique per account (natural key) across SCD2 versions; used to join to presentation/fact layers.

business_meaning: Source customer identifier (owner of the account)
documented_rules: Source system customer ID; one customer can hold several accounts. [[2]]
inferred_rules: Must reference a valid customer in source/DimParty; non-null for retail accounts.

documented_rules: Allowed example values: EASY_ACCESS, FIXED_1Y, NOTICE_90, ISA. [[3]]
inferred_rules: Must match a valid product in DimProduct; when ProductCode = FIXED_1Y then AccountMaturityDate must be populated.

documented_rules: Allowed example values: OPEN, CLOSED, DORMANT, FROZEN. [[4]]
inferred_rules: When AccountStatus = CLOSED then AccountCloseDate must be populated; status should be consistent with Balance and transaction history.

documented_rules: Currency is char(3) and in the PoC always GBP. [[5]]
inferred_rules: ISO-4217 3-letter code; non-null; for this PoC expect 'GBP'.

documented_rules: AccountOpenDate: Date the account was opened. [[6]]
inferred_rules: Must be <= today; must be <= AccountMaturityDate when that is populated; must be <= AccountCloseDate when that is populated.

documented_rules: AccountMaturityDate: Date a fixed-term account matures; Nullable; mandatory when ProductCode = FIXED_1Y. [[7]]
inferred_rules: When populated must be >= AccountOpenDate; required when ProductCode = FIXED_1Y; null for non-term products.

documented_rules: AccountCloseDate: Date the account was closed; Nullable; mandatory when AccountStatus = CLOSED. [[8]]
inferred_rules: When populated must be >= AccountOpenDate; if AccountStatus = CLOSED then non-null and typically <= today; should be null for OPEN accounts.
Must be >= 0; reasonable upper bound may be applied in downstream checks (e.g., < 100%); should be consistent with ProductCode (e.g., FIXED_1Y fixed vs EASY_ACCESS variable).

documented_rules: Balance in GBP; business rule: must be 0.00 when AccountStatus = CLOSED. [[10]]
inferred_rules: Must be >= 0 for most retail accounts unless overdraft allowed in another product; if AccountStatus = CLOSED then Balance = 0.00; numeric precision decimal(18,2).

business_meaning: Curate SCD2 start timestamp for this row/version
documented_rules: Curate SCD2 start timestamp; used as authoritative ETL effective timestamp; FactSavingsAccount LoadDate is taken from Curate.ValidFrom. [[11]]
inferred_rules: Non-null; ValidFrom < ValidTo; used as load/effective timestamp for downstream facts.

business_meaning: Curate SCD2 end timestamp for this row/version
documented_rules: Curate SCD2 end timestamp; 9999-12-31 denotes current version. [[12]]
inferred_rules: Non-null; ValidTo > ValidFrom; current version uses ValidTo = 9999-12-31; ValidFrom/ValidTo ranges for same AccountNumber must not overlap.

business_meaning: ETL load timestamp for this curate row
documented_rules: LoadTimestamp: ETL load timestamp for this curate row. [[13]]
inferred_rules: Non-null; monotonic per row-version; for incremental loads should reflect commit time; LoadTimestamp typically >= ValidFrom.
